headline: Max Payne and bullet time
title: Max Payne 2001 | The Bullet Time Game | Classic Games
video_script: Max Payne came out in two thousand one, made by Remedy from Finland. It made bullet time famous, where everything slows down and you can dodge while firing. Max is a New York cop, and his story is told through comic book style panels. Do you remember Max Payne? Comment below!

scenes.sub: A unique way to tell the story

description: Max Payne (2001, Remedy) - the game that made bullet time famous, told through comic book panels.
